summary: Implemented the Lambda and Lambdad transforms per the spec, without committing or running any repo code. Changes: (1) monai/transforms/utility/array.py: Lambda(Transform) appended at the end, asserting callable(func) with message "func must be callable"; __call__ returns func(img) unchanged. (2) monai/transforms/utility/dictionary.py: Callable added to the typing import; Lambda added to the array import list; Lambdad(MapTransform) inserted after ConcatItemsd, building one internal Lambda(func) and applying it to each listed key on a dict(data) copy; LambdaD = LambdaDict = Lambdad appended as the last alias line. (3) docs/source/transforms.rst: Lambda entry placed before SplitChannel in Vanilla Transforms, and Lambdad entry after ConcatItemsd in Dictionary-based Transforms. (4) tests/test_lambda.py and tests/test_lambdad.py: subclass NumpyImageTestCase2D, cover identity and slicing callables (slicing keeps batch and channel axes whole), the keys-view form, input immutability, aliases, non-callable AssertionError, and empty-keys ValueError for Lambdad. Notes: SplitChannel actually lives in monai/transforms/post/array.py; the docs entry was placed by name. Tests were not run per instruction; verification was by reading the diff and checking line lengths against the 120-column limit.
